period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) as at 2022-09-30. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2022 (as published in the FY2022 annual report's own 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table), NOT discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix; discrete-quarter figures were not computed by subtraction, per project convention (same as CITYBANK). Table title itself does not say 'Consolidated' or 'Solo' ('Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board'), but its own Dec-31-2022 column reproduces total_assets (353,643.68), gross_loans (253,835.69), total_deposits (232,657.44), total_liabilities (332,312.41) and total_equity (21,331.13) matching the already-confirmed-CONSOLIDATED 2022_Q4.json to within normal rounding, confirming this table is Consolidated basis too -- same basis as the rest of MTB's series, no mismatch. Dec-31-2022 column cross-checked against the already-stored 2022_Q4.json (sourced from mtb-annual-report-2023.txt (retrospective comparative)): total_assets, gross_loans, total_deposits, total_liabilities, total_equity, operating_income, tax_expense and profit_after_tax all match to within ordinary whole-million rounding (largest drift <0.08%) -- no discrepancy found for 2022. (gross_loans has a trivial ~0.01% drift below the flagging threshold, not detailed here.) Balance-sheet identity (Total Property and Assets = Total Liabilities + Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity + Non-Controlling Interest) validated exactly (max drift BDT 0.01m, pure decimal-rounding noise) for all four quarters of 2022, including this Q3. Non-Controlling Interest (~BDT 0.13-0.14m) is omitted as its own line item here (rounds to 0 in whole millions) but is included in the identity check above. Cumulative Total Operating Income, Net Profit After Tax and Interest Income all increase monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 for 2022 (Q1=3,336.82, Q2=7,260.47, Q3=12,535.51 for operating income; Q1=634.02, Q2=1,336.63, Q3=2,233.20 for net profit after tax) -- no violation.
